title: Zero influence for width-zero inputs
statement: Let $T$ be a circuit tail with $m$ inputs, let $g$ be an AND or OR gate, and assign a sign-valued Boolean function to each input on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Suppose every input function has a gate-appropriate conjunctive or disjunctive normal form of width at most zero. Then the total influence of the real-valued function obtained by evaluating $T$ is zero.
